The '''Gourmand Statue''' is decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It can be found by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the [[Ginger Island#Pirate Cove|pirate cove]] on Ginger Island Southeast (5% chance)<ref name="gourmandchance" />. Multiple statues can be obtained.

The Gourmand Statue can be placed anywhere in Stardew Valley or on Ginger Island, whether indoors or outdoors.
